claims.value: MIA PaCa-2-R soluble protein fraction (1-10) / MIA PaCa-2-R membrane protein fraction (11-20) / MIA PaCa-2 parental soluble protein fraction (21-30) / MIA PaCa-2 parental membrane protein fraction (31-40)
claims.evidence: Paper Methods "Proteome Labeling and Cell Fractionation": two cell populations (radioresistant MIA PaCa-2-R, parental MIA PaCa-2), each split into soluble (100,000 x g supernatant) and membrane (RIPA-solubilised pellet) proteins; equal amounts of soluble (resp. membrane) proteins from the two populations mixed and run on separate gel lanes. Source names are curator-chosen identifiers for (population x subcellular fraction).

Paper/PRIDE protocol: "The radioresistant MIA PaCa-2-R cells were cultured in unlabeled DMEM ... (light medium)". PRIDE:0000326 = SILAC light (OLS). Cross-check: membrane proteinGroups 5NTD_HUMAN (CD73, reported up-regulated in radioresistant cells) Ratio H/L = 0.0599, vimentin H/L 0.55 (membrane) / 0.55 (soluble) -> light channel carries the radioresistant cells; no label swap (single SILAC experiment per fraction, no replicates).

Paper/PRIDE protocol: "the parental MIA PaCa-2 cells were cultured in labeled DMEM medium containing arginine-13C6 and lysine-13C615N2 (heavy medium)". PRIDE:0000325 = SILAC heavy. Search tables carry only L and H intensities (2-plex, no medium channel).

files/all lists exactly 20 RAW files: Soluble-1..10 and Membrane-1..10. Paper: "the entire lane ... was cut into 10 slices"; separate SDS-PAGE lanes for the soluble and membrane mixes. Every RAW file appears once per SILAC channel (2 rows per file).

claims.value: file stem (Soluble-N / Membrane-N), shared by the light and heavy rows of one run
claims.evidence: One assay per data file; the two SILAC channels of a run share it and are distinguished by comment[label].

claims.value: 1-10 = numeric suffix of the RAW file name
claims.evidence: Paper: 10 gel slices per lane. Mapping slice k -> file "<fraction>-k.RAW" is inferred from the file names (not stated explicitly).
Each slice injected once; no technical replicates described.

Paper "Experimental Design and Statistical Rationale": "Instead of performing biological replicates in the SILAC proteomic analysis, we fractionated cellular proteins into soluble and membrane fractions and analyzed them independently".
PRIDE organism Homo sapiens; Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 OX NCBI_TaxID=9606.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 "Derived from site: In situ; Pancreas; UBERON=UBERON_0001264"; UBERON:0001264 = pancreas.

Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 DI NCIt C5722 "Pancreatic undifferentiated carcinoma"; MONDO:0006478 = undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma (OLS). Paper says "pancreatic cancer cell line". Disease of the donor of the cell line; both arms are the same cell line.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 AG 65Y (donor age at sampling).

Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 "Population: Caucasian" (genome ancestry ~86% European North+South, PubMed 30894373) -> HANCESTRO:0005 European ancestry (label verified in OLS). Donor-level property of the cell line, same for both arms.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 donor age 65Y -> EFO:0001272 adult (verified in OLS). Donor stage, not a cell property.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 SX Male.

Paper: parental MIA PaCa-2 and its irradiation-selected derivative MIA PaCa-2-R (clone #6). Cellosaurus CVCL_0428 lists 10 child lines (GEM-MIA PaCa-2, HyCyte KO-hSNAP23, HyCyte ABHD17C, MIA PaCa-2 GR2000/GR300/GR800, MIA PaCa-2/CMV-Luc, MiaPaCa(BCRP), MiaPaCa-2 F-RFP, PH61-N); none is this radioresistant clone, and CLO/EFO have no entry for it. Both arms therefore carry the parental line name; the arm is in source name and treatment.

PRIDE record organismParts lists CvParam CL:0000066 "Epithelial cell" (OLS label: epithelial cell). Caveat: the paper shows MIA PaCa-2-R cells in a mesenchymal-like (EMT) state; the value describes the cell line's epithelial origin as recorded by the submitter.
Cellosaurus ID MIA PaCa-2, AC CVCL_0428. Rows 1-20 are a non-catalogued derivative of this line.
Cellosaurus ID line.
Paper: cells maintained in DMEM; SILAC culture in unlabeled (light) or Arg-13C6/Lys-13C6-15N2 (heavy) DMEM with 10% dialyzed FBS. NCIT:C185409 = Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium.

Paper: "Stable radioresistant cells were generated by exposing MIA PaCa-2 cells to a total dose of 60 Gy of gamma-radiation over 6 weeks (2 Gy per day ...)". NCIT:C44386 = Gamma Radiation. This is the selection history of the derived line (cells were not irradiated immediately before harvest); radioresistant vs parental is the compared variable. The value records how the resistant clone was selected (selection history), not an acute irradiation before harvest: surviving clones were expanded and maintained like the parental cells. Paper Results: "The radioresistance was stable and was retained after more than 30 passages."

Parental MIA PaCa-2 cells were not irradiated; they are the untreated comparator of the study factor. The sample-metadata template prescribes "untreated" for controls (the reserved word "not applicable" would wrongly say the concept does not apply).

Paper: "analyzed by LC-MS/MS using a LTQ-Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer"; PRIDE says the less specific "LTQ Orbitrap". RAW headers read only the family strings "LTQ Orbitrap MS" / "Thermo Finnigan LTQ" (model block not reached by range read); Nth Order Double Play method with FTMS MS1 + ITMS MS2 is consistent with an LTQ Orbitrap XL.
Paper: "operated in a data-dependent mode"; RAW method: "ITMS + c norm ... Dep MS/MS Most intense ion from (1)", "Scan Event 2 repeated for top 5 peaks".
RAW method header (Soluble-1, Soluble-10, Membrane-1): "Activation Type: CID".
RAW method header: "Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0".
RAW method: MS2 scan event is "ITMS" (LTQ linear ion trap, radial ejection). MS:1000083 verified in OLS.
RAW method scan event 1: "FTMS + p norm !corona !pi o(375.0-1500.0)".
Paper: "in-gel digestion with trypsin (Promega)"; MaxQuant search with max 2 missed cleavages.
Paper: mixed proteins "fractionated by a 12% SDS-PAGE gel ... the entire lane ... was cut into 10 slices". PRIDE:0000568 (SDS PAGE) is a descendant of PRIDE:0000550 (Fractionation method).
Paper/PRIDE data processing protocol: "The MS error tolerance was set to 4.5 ppm" (MaxQuant 1.6.2.10 main-search tolerance). No mqpar.xml/parameters.txt deposited.
Paper/PRIDE: "the fixed modification of cysteine carbamidomethylation". No mqpar.xml deposited; deposited proteinGroups/peptides tables cannot show fixed mods.
Paper: "variable modifications of ... oxidation on methionine"; deposited MaxQuant tables carry an "Oxidation (M) site IDs" column.

Paper/PRIDE: "variable modifications of acetylation at peptide N terminus". Encoded as Any N-term per the stated wording; MaxQuant's usual default is Acetyl (Protein N-term) and no mqpar.xml is deposited to confirm.

Heavy medium contained arginine-13C6 (Arg6, +6.020 Da) -> UNIMOD:188 Label:13C(6) on R. MaxQuant tables report H/L ratios (multiplicity 2). Encoded as Variable, the convention for SILAC labels in curated SDRFs (e.g. bigbio PXD000228).
Heavy medium contained lysine-13C6-15N2 (Lys8, +8.014 Da) -> UNIMOD:259 Label:13C(6)15N(2) on K.
Filled by sdrf-tools build from the ms-proteomics template.
SDRF-Proteomics specification version v1.1.0 (README.adoc line 27, same at upstream HEAD). Independent of template versions.

Mass spectrometry DDA study of a human cell line (MIA PaCa-2 and derivative); no patient/clinical data. ms-proteomics v1.2.0 is the released latest in bigbio/sdrf-templates HEAD 7da1747 templates.yaml line 150 (the pinned spec submodule only carries 1.1.0).
Unattended sdrf-skills sdrf-annotate run (tables expanded by sdrf-tools build); version 0.1.0 from the sdrf-skills pyproject.toml.

limitations: Fragment mass tolerance is "not available": the paper states MS/MS tolerance 20 ppm (MaxQuant FTMS default), but the RAW method shows MS2 in the ion trap (ITMS), whose MaxQuant tolerance (default 0.5 Da) is not stated anywhere and no mqpar.xml/parameters.txt/summary.txt is deposited. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms fails on this column (see validation.txt).

No MaxQuant mqpar.xml / parameters.txt / summary.txt deposited; modifications and SILAC label amino acids are from the paper/PRIDE protocol, only Oxidation (M) and the 2-plex L/H design are confirmed by the deposited proteinGroups/peptides tables. Acetyl encoded as PP=Any N-term following the paper wording ("peptide N terminus"); MaxQuant may have used Acetyl (Protein N-term).
Instrument model string (XL) not found in the range-read RAW header (only "LTQ Orbitrap MS" family string in first 8 MB and last 4 MB); LTQ Orbitrap XL taken from the paper. techsdrf not installed.
Gel slice number -> RAW file suffix mapping (fraction identifier) inferred from file names.

MIA PaCa-2-R (radioresistant derivative) has no Cellosaurus/CLO/EFO entry; annotated with parental MIA PaCa-2 cell line / CVCL_0428 plus characteristics[treatment] = Gamma Radiation for the selection history.
Soluble vs membrane protein fraction is recorded only in source name: no template-licensed characteristics column for subcellular fraction exists in ms-proteomics/human/cell-lines.
